## The short answer

::: block
Viruses are the most abundant biological entities on Earth, and they live in
every kind of ecosystem there is.

[Most of them cause no disease at all.]{.claim}

We picture them as the things that give us the flu, and some of them are. But
the pathogens are a minority of a much larger population that spends its time
killing bacteria, moving genes between hosts, and turning over the biomass of
whole ecosystems. The human body is one of those ecosystems.
:::
